body_text:
Rank--nullity theorem. If $T:V\to W$ is linear and $V$ is
finite-dimensional, then
$\dim V=\dim\ker T+\dim\operatorname{im}T$. The theorem measures
the domain as the sum of information destroyed by $T$ and
information retained in its image. Consequently $T$ is injective
exactly when its nullity is zero.
